description: The model's active articles not yet on Amazon become ONE listing with variations — Amazon's "variation family"; call it a model with variations when talking to the user: a parent whose SKU is the model's code (no price, no quantity) and a child listing per article, varying by colour and/or size — the theme is chosen from what the Amazon product type declares. Every listing is first validated by Amazon (VALIDATION_PREVIEW); this tool only checks and creates nothing. Returns parentSku, theme, blocker (tooFewArticles, noAxis, missingAxisValue, duplicateCombination, themeUnsupported, parentSkuTaken, parentTitleTooLong, tooManyArticles — with the SKUs concerned), parentIssues, per article missing requirements (productType, brand, images, condition, title, price), fields (what the product type still needs, found against Amazon's own schema: attribute key, title in the marketplace's language, kind missing or invalid, allowed values with labels, units) and Amazon's sentences, and skipped articles (already on Amazon, taken off the channel). The CRM fills model_name, list_price and the dimensions itself; set any other field as a characteristic named exactly like its title (upsert_product_attributes), on every article. Then create it with publish_amazon_variation_family.

modelId.description: A product model id (the model a product's modelId points at; get_product shows it).
